text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Shares of newly privatised electricity company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal were admitted to Lisbon bourse and closed at 3,099 escudos, 37.07 percent more than the privatisation price.
- Rui Rio has resigned as general secretary of the opposition Social Democrat Party. His substitute is Horta e Costa.
- Audit Court discovered that Madeira has an overdraft at the Bank of Portugal, which could harm Madeira's access to EU funds.
- Solidarity Minister Ferro Rodrigues plans to increase the social security fund by 100 billion escudos, a government source said.
- Building group Gestifer was the strategic partner chosen by North American company EuroAmer to develop real estate projects in Portugal, totalling 100 billion escudos.
